subject: MAP inspection: runway drift causal log & escalation path
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Park <lauren@novaretail.com>, Procurement Ops <procure@novaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP inspection: initial note on runway drift

Hi Lauren / Nova procurement team —

Quick heads-up after reviewing the MAP and the recent cadence: we surfaced a pattern of downstream blocking items that are re-phasing the close from late March to mid-April unless we act. Primary observations:

- Procurement sign-off is paused pending SOC 2 evidence (controls description + cert timeline).
- Legal redlines on the SLA section were passed back yesterday and require one consolidated run-through.
- Integration pilot window kept slipping; engineering is now requesting dedicated staging time the week of 3/31.

I attached an updated MAP that annotates owners and dates (MAP_v2.xlsx). Please confirm if the SOC 2 evidence ETA you shared earlier (end of month) still stands, and whether Procurement can move to an expedited review given the timeline sensitivity.

Proposed next steps:
1) Short 30-min sync today (if possible) to align owners and decide whether we need a formal amendment to the close date.
2) We’ll prepare a short risk register and a mitigation proposal if procurement needs an extra 2–3 weeks.
3) If commitments shift materially, we’ll trigger a sales leadership escalation.

Appreciate a quick reply with availability.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Lauren Park <lauren@novaretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@novaretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Mar 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP inspection: initial note on runway drift

Thanks for the flag, Karthik. Short answers:

- SOC 2: our security team has the controls package but the external attestation date slipped to 3/28 because the auditor requested an evidence set update (we only got that last Friday). I expect the final report by 3/28–3/30, but we can share the interim evidence bundle sooner.
- Legal redlines: our counsel returned a few edits; nothing categorical but a couple of SLA measurement points need clarification.
- Staging: engineering can free up a half-day window week of 3/24; full pilot week is tight.

We do not want to stretch the close unnecessarily — our quarter targets are locked — but procurement cannot approve without the SOC evidence in some form. Happy to join a short sync today; I’m available 2–2:45pm PT.

Lauren Park
Head of Platform Partnerships, Nova Retail
lauren@novaretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Park <lauren@novaretail.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP inspection: runway drift causal log & escalation path

Karthik / Monica / Lauren —

Following our sync this morning, I’m attaching the risk register I promised (slip_risk_register.csv). Key entries summarized below (root causes + probability + immediate mitigations):

- SOC 2 evidence delay: probability HIGH. Mitigation: send interim evidence bundle + formal attestation timeline; offer temporary data-scoped pilot (redacted PII) to unblock procurement. Owner: Nova security / Procurement (requested) + Redwood security to prepare evidence package.

- Legal SLA clarifications: probability MED. Mitigation: redline consolidation session with both counsels; propose a single carve for measurement dispute resolution. Owner: Nova legal + Redwood legal (Marissa to coordinate).

- Staging window shortage: probability MED. Mitigation: propose a focused integration slice (MVP tests) that can run in the single half-day week of 3/24; full pilot deferred to week of 3/31 if SOC arrives. Owner: Nova eng + Redwood solutions (Monica).

If the SOC attestation cannot be provided by 3/30, we should assume a forced close-date move and prepare an official amendment. I recommend the following escalation trigger matrix:

- Trigger A (High): SOC evidence not provided by 2025-03-30 -> mandatory Exec-to-Exec call and proposed close-date shift of +14 calendar days.
- Trigger B (Medium): Legal redline open at 2025-03-25 -> run legal consolidation; contingency minor SLA clause to be used temporarily.

I’ve included suggested text for an amendment (see slip_risk_register.csv, final tab). If we need to escalate, I’ll pull VP Sales and legal on the exec call.

Marissa
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: slip_risk_register.csv (text/csv)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Park <lauren@novaretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 17:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP inspection: runway drift causal log & escalation path

Thanks all — and especially Lauren for the clarity on SOC timing. To synthesize and propose a path forward:

1) Immediate: Lauren, could you share the interim evidence bundle by EOD tomorrow (3/13)? Redwood security will compile a short attestation summary we can pass to Nova procurement.

2) Near-term pilot: Monica, please coordinate the focused integration slice for 3/24 (half day). Confirm specific test cases tomorrow so Nova can free the slot.

3) Amendment: if the evidence isn’t in by 3/30 we’ll proceed with Trigger A. To avoid last-minute chaos, I’m recommending we prepare and provisionally load a short amendment document for signature that moves the close by 14 days and confirms the pilot gating conditions. I’ve attached a draft amendment for quick review (amendment_draft.docx) and included a DocuSign link below for when both sides are aligned.

Proposal: Redwood offers a limited good-faith credit (5% of first-year committed spend) if the amendment is executed; this is to help Nova maintain Q2 vendor budgets while we preserve delivery commitments. If that’s acceptable, I’ll escalate draft terms to legal and pull in VP Sales for sign-off.

Suggested times for an Exec-to-Exec call (if Trigger A occurs): Thu 3/27 10am PT or Mon 3/31 9am PT.

DocuSign (provisional): https://app.docusign.com/AMEND/NR-4792
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/NR-4792
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3D4E5F6G7H8I

Karthik
